about: Generated art for the website: key art, store capsules, share cards, logo lockups. Not game captures: each is shown only as a labelled illustration (or, for a logo or wordmark, where nobody reads it as gameplay). Prompts are in docs/key-art-prompts.md; tools/website-check.mjs enforces the fields and where the art may appear.

format.file: file name in website/art/, e.g. key-art-16x9.jpg
format.use: key-art | capsule | social-card | logo | wordmark | illustration
format.tool: what made it, e.g. ChatGPT (GPT image), with any finishing tool after it
format.prompt: the exact prompt used, plus any follow-up edits asked for
format.source: the game capture attached as reference, e.g. review-media/landscape-pnw.jpg (null only for a logo or wordmark)
format.sha256: hash of the file as committed (shasum -a 256 website/art/<file>)
format.notes: optional: crop, resize, who approved it
